ranges.quote: The moment I realized everything I'd been doing was wrong was a Tuesday afternoon.
ranges.reason: Best hook in all 3 clips. Energy peaks at 'Tuesday' — cut before breath at 18.6s.

ranges.quote: We were shipping faster than ever, but nothing was landing...
ranges.reason: Only take without background HVAC noise after 90s. Strong emotional delivery.

ranges.quote: So I stopped doing everything I thought I knew, and started asking.
ranges.reason: Clean delivery. Speaker looks directly at camera for the payoff line.

ranges.quote: If you're in the same place I was — just start. The clarity comes from doing.
ranges.reason: Emotional close. Fade out naturally after 34.2s.
